Stock: split 12 in logs into eighths with the chainsaw (0.25 in kerf), then bandsaw each eighth down its length into 2 slices (0.0625 in kerf),
keeping the cuts on the radius so every slice is a true sector.
Lay the rings from the frame inward. Each ring is a small frame: three pieces in the same pinwheel as the frame -- each runs from the far side of the
piece behind it to the near side of the piece ahead, square-cut both ends in plan.
1/16 slice (a wedge bandsawn in two): pieces
1/16 slice (a wedge bandsawn in two): sticks 6 ft
